reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and for a compliant finding no redline or comment is expected — the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no comment was added, which is correct.

The cited text supports compliance: fees are usage-based on actual Monthly Notional Volume (p0070's floor is tied to volume actually recorded as traded, not a minimum commitment or make-whole), Art. IV (p0049) only preserves the Licensor's right to accrued payments for trades actually performed, and Art. XXIII (p0142) expressly bars termination damages for both parties — so no liquidated damages, penalty or early-termination fee is payable by us (Licensee = Customer side).

Rationale correctly notes the non-LD items (audit cost-shift on >5% discrepancy; 33% Supplemental Payments) as cost-reimbursement and revenue-share consideration rather than breach- or exit-triggered penalties, consistent with the rule's instruction to flag only Customer-payable LDs.
No deterministic check failures; retaining this as internal compliance evidence rather than a negotiation issue is appropriate.
